title: Trump says the UFO issue is being looked into; aliens.gov registered

tellings.quote: this talk of disclosure now and Trump is, you know, Trump and Obama engaged in some sort of bizarre mimetic warfare like a couple months ago and Trump's now saying we're looking into the UFO issue.

plain: President Donald Trump is now saying that the government is looking into the UFO issue, according to Michels, who says this came a couple of months after an odd public back-and-forth between Trump and former president Barack Obama on the subject. Michels says this himself, as part of the current talk of disclosure, meaning the government openly releasing what it knows about UFOs. If it goes anywhere, it would be the White House putting its own weight behind the question.
